name: Bouncer
text: On Recruit: the next two rivals’ turns are skipped.

name: Clockmaker
text: On Recruit: +1 purple per 2 purple you have. Round Start: +1 purple per 2 purple you have.

name: Closer
text: When you place the last minion of the round: +4 purple.

name: Courier
text: Whenever you take an extra turn, +1 of each other color.

name: Shift Crew
text: Worth 2 followers.

name: Early Bird
text: Your turns can’t be skipped.

name: Extra Shift
text: On Recruit: +1 minion this round.

name: Gossip
text: Whenever a player’s turn is skipped, +1 follower.

name: Late Riser
text: Round Start: if you have the fewest followers (ties count), take an extra turn before anyone places.

name: Night Owl
text: Once per round: after you place your last minion, take an extra turn.

name: Go-Getter
text: Once per game: take an extra turn after this one.

name: Hot Streak
text: Once per game: +3 followers per turn in a row you’ve taken just before this one.

name: Timekeepers
text: Game end: +1 follower per purple member you have.

name: Broker
text: Whenever a White action gives you followers, +1 follower.

name: Cashier
text: On Recruit: turn all your white into followers.

name: Exporter
text: Whenever you recruit a non-white member, +1 white.

name: Heiress
text: Once per game: +1 white per member you have.

name: Hoarder
text: Once per game: turn all your resources into white.

name: Martyr
text: When this member leaves your cult, gain followers equal to its cost.

name: Old Money
text: Game end: +1 follower per white member you have.

name: Raiders
text: Once per game: steal 4 followers from the leader. Pay them 2 white.

name: Recluse
text: Game end: +2 followers per rival with more members than you.

name: Shopkeeper
text: On Recruit: +2 white. Round Start: +2 white.

name: Undertaker
text: Whenever you cast out one of your members, +2 followers.
